table.name: Ignition Cut - Switch Input
table.description: Arms Ignition Cut V7 at the proven six-channel P1L final-stage charge gate. Spark is cut only at or above the configured RPM, except that Launch Control V4 may independently request spark cut through fd5a.7.

table.name: Ignition Cut - RPM Limit
table.description: Spark-cut threshold stored as RPM/32. Example: 6880 RPM = raw 0xD7.

table.name: LC - Switch / Mode
table.description: Arms Launch Control V4. The clutch input arms the latch; speed and throttle release it.

table.name: LC - Cut Type
table.description: Fuel mode uses the native staged limiter with independent soft and hard RPM thresholds. Ignition mode raises fd5a.7 at the soft threshold and requires Ignition Cut V7.

table.name: LC - Clutch Polarity
table.description: Electrical sense of the clutch or toggle input.

table.name: LC - Soft Cut RPM
table.description: Lower launch threshold stored as RPM/32. Fuel mode begins the stock staged injector cut here; ignition mode requests spark cut here. Example: 4000 RPM = raw 0x7D.

table.name: LC - Hard Cut RPM
table.description: Upper fuel-mode threshold stored as RPM/32. It must be at or above Soft Cut RPM; firmware clamps a lower value to the soft threshold. Raw 0xFF is the unconfigured sentinel and safely uses Soft Cut RPM + 96 RPM, saturating instead of wrapping.

table.name: LC - Arm Speed
table.description: Near-standstill arming guard. A clutch press at or above this speed does not arm a cleared latch.

table.name: LC - Max Speed
table.description: Releases the launch latch once vehicle speed reaches this value. Must be greater than Arm Speed.

table.name: LC - Min TPS
table.description: Continuous throttle gate. Dropping below this value immediately clears the launch latch.

table.name: VANOS Retrofit - Minimum RPM (Closed Throttle)
table.description: Minimum RPM for closed-throttle VANOS engagement added by the tested MS41.0 VANOSRT1 retrofit. Raw 0xFF preserves stock behavior; use only after that patch is installed.
